chunks: 4942 - And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever attributes to me what I did not say, let him take his seat in the Fire."

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.عَلَيَّ: against me or attributed to me
key_terms.فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ: let him take for himself or prepare for himself
key_terms.مَقْعَدَهُ: his seat or place of sitting

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for falsely attributing words to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This hadith warns severely against fabricating statements and falsely attributing them to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله. It emphasizes the grave sin of distorting the Prophetic tradition and links such falsehood to punishment in the Fire.
